test_text_feature: test the Text feature encodes plain strings as UTF-8 bytes with shape () and dtype np.str_
test_text_encoded: test the Text feature with ByteTextEncoder encodes unicode strings as integer lists with shape (None,) and dtype np.int64
test_text_conversion: test the Text feature round-trips strings through str2ints and ints2str conversion methods
test_save_load_metadata: test saving and loading Text feature metadata with a ByteTextEncoder that has additional_tokens
test_load_metadata_without_encoder: test that loading Text feature metadata without an encoder raises a ValueError
